lowZScoreThreshold.description:
The threshold below which the average feature drift z-score between the reference data and comparison
data is considered to be low drift.

highZScoreThreshold.description:
The threshold above which the average feature drift z-score between the reference data and comparison
data is considered to be high drift.

earlyDeviationPercentile.description:
The threshold below which the risk score distributions between the reference data and comparison data
is considered to deviate early.

lateDeviationPercentile.description:
The threshold above which the risk score distributions between the reference data and comparison data
is considered to deviate late.

highMAERatioThreshold.description:
The threshold above which the MAE ratio between the comparison data and the reference data is considered
to be too high.

redScore.description:
The score that should be assigned to a red (bad) model. This score should be between 0-1, with a higher value
indicating that the model performs better.

yellowScore.description: The score that should be assigned to a yellow model.

greenScore.description: The score that should be assigned to a green (good) model.

lookbackDaysStart.description: Number of days between the start of monitoring time range and today.

lookbackDaysEnd.description: Number of days between the end of monitoring time range and today. The value should be smaller than {@link #lookbackDaysStart}.

title: This spec is used to configure how to monitor a given {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}.
name: ReliabilityRiskMlModel.MonitoringScoreSpec
